subject_terms: bachelor of science in food technology
bachelor of science in food technology

en: Bachelor of Science in Food Technology is a four-year degree program design to develop professionals in food technology. The program focuses on a mix of pure and applied science, engineering, business, and entrepreneurial skills. It aims to produce professionals who have the capacity to apply the science and technology and related fields of study in post-harvest handling, preparation, processing, packaging, storage, distribution, and marketing of food to ensure food and nutrition security, quality, environmental sustainability and the well-being of individuals, families and communities. The program also aims to promote continued excellence in food science education.

Ang programa nagpunting sa kombinasyon sa pure ug applied science, engineering, business, ug entrepreneurial skills. Tumong niini ang pag-produce og mga propesyonal nga adunay kapasidad sa paggamit sa siyensya ug teknolohiya ug uban pang may kalabotan nga larangan sa post-harvest handling, preparation, processing, packaging, storage, distribution, ug marketing sa pagkaon aron masiguro ang food ug nutrition security, kalidad, environmental sustainability, ug kaayohan sa mga indibidwal, pamilya, ug komunidad. Ang programa usab nagtumong sa pagpalambo sa padayon nga kahusayan sa food science education.

subject_terms: bachelor of science in entertainment and multimedia computing

en: The Bachelor of Science in Entertainment and Multimedia Computing is the study and use of concepts, principles, and techniques of computing in the design and development of multimedia products and solutions. It includes various applications such as in science, entertainment, education, simulations and advertising.

The program enables the students to be knowledgeable of the whole pipeline of Digital Animation projects. The students will acquire the independence and creative competencies to articulate project design and requirements of new projects, not necessarily based on standard templates.

ceb: Ang Bachelor of Science in Entertainment and Multimedia Computing mao ang pagtuon ug paggamit sa mga konsepto, prinsipyo, ug teknik sa computing sa pagdesinyo ug pag-develop sa multimedia products ug solutions. Naglakip kini og lain-laing aplikasyon sama sa science, entertainment, education, simulations, ug advertising.

Ang programa naghatag sa estudyante og kahibalo sa tibuok proseso sa Digital Animation projects. Ang mga estudyante makabaton og independence ug creative competencies aron ma-articulate ang project design ug requirements sa bag-ong proyekto, dili lang base sa standard templates.

Ang Digital Animation Technology major mao ang pagtuon ug aplikasyon sa fundamental ug advanced nga teorya ug teknik sa 2D ug 3D animation, paggamit ug pag-develop alang sa pag-uswag sa animation technologies ug paghimo sa commercially acceptable content ug viable solutions para sa lain-laing platforms sama sa broadcast, web, ug mobile cast.

en: Here is the key difference between board and non-board courses at BukSU:

• **Board Courses:** Degree programs that require graduates to take and pass a national licensure examination (Board Exam) administered by the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) or government regulatory body (e.g., Nursing, Teacher Education, Accountancy) before they can legally practice their profession.

• **Non-Board Courses:** Degree programs that do not require a national board examination. Graduates are fully qualified to enter their chosen professional careers upon receiving their college diploma (e.g., Information Technology, Public Administration, Development Communication).
ceb: Ania ang nag-unang kalainan tali sa board ug non-board courses sa BukSU:

• **Board Courses:** Mga degree program nga nagkinahanglan nga makapasar ang mga graduate sa PRC Licensure Examination o Board Exam (sama sa Nursing, Teacher Education, Accountancy) aron legal nga makapraktis sa ilang propesyon.

• **Non-Board Courses:** Mga degree program nga dili na nagkinahanglan og board exam. Ang mga graduate kwalipikado na nga direktang manarbaho human makadawat sa ilang diploma sa kolehiyo (sama sa Information Technology, Public Administration, Development Communication).

en: Unfortunately, we are not allowed to release the exact CAT score required to qualify for specific programs (non-board or board courses), since this may change every year. We can only provide a percentage range.

NOTE: This range is based only on past BukSU CAT examinations. This may change over the years. It is much better to ask the BukSU Admission Testing Unit (ATU) for specific qualification information:
https://www.facebook.com/BukSUATU
Or you can view your BukSU Admission Examination CAT score to know if you are qualified for non-board or board courses.

For board courses, the range is 70% to 90% Again, this is only a range and it may change in the long run. For non-board courses, the range is 45% to 69%. Below that is considered as failed to pass the BukSU CAT examination.
ceb: Sa pagkakaron, dili namo pwede i-release ang eksaktong CAT score nga kinahanglan aron ma-qualify sa specific nga mga programa (non-board o board courses), tungod kay kini mahimong mausab matag tuig. Makahatag lamang mi og percentage range.

https://www.facebook.com/BukSUATU
O pwede pud nimo tan-awon ang imong BukSU Admission Examination CAT score aron mahibal-an kung qualified ka para sa non-board o board courses.

Para sa board courses, ang range kay 70% hangtod 90% Hinumdumi, range lamang kini ug mahimong mausab sa kadugayan. Para sa non-board courses, ang range kay 45% hangtod 69%. Kung ubos pa niini, giisip nga wala nakapasar sa BukSU CAT examination.
